title: centaurium calycosum var. arizonicum
intro: Centaurium calycosum var. arizonicum, commonly known as Arizona centaury or Arizona rampion bellflower, is a plant species belonging to the family Gentianaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including coughs, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium calycosum var. arizonicum include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to relieve congestion, reduce inflammation, and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicrin, gentiogenin, and gentiin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
